The '''Crystalline Dark Beast''' is a mini-boss monster found in the [[Gauntlet]] that attacks with [[Ranged]]. Its counterpart in the [[The Gauntlet#Corrupted Gauntlet|Corrupted Gauntlet]] is the [[Corrupted Dark Beast]]. Mini-boss monsters always spawn alone, and only appear at the edges of the Gauntlet map. Unlike regular [[Dark Beast]]s, it does not require a [[Slayer]] level to be harmed.
